 ◢◤ Keys                                      
 On this screen                               
   ↑↓       select                            
                                              
   a–z      shortcuts                         
                                              
                                              
 Anywhere                                     
   ctrl+b   the menu                          
                                              
   ctrl+s   save answers                      
                                              
   ctrl+l   layout: auto (compact)            
                                              
   ctrl+y   theme: interzone                  
                                              
   q        quit, when not typing             
                                              
   ctrl+c   quit
